textRuns.value: Methods: exact great-circle nearest-site search and a people-weighted Gini (hospitals); network walking catchments (buses); Mann-Kendall, Sen slope and Benjamini-Hochberg (rain trends); ridge regression against persistence, climatology and a LightGBM challenger, with a paired block bootstrap (drought model); Moran's I and a variogram (spatial errors). Notebooks 02, 04, 08, 10, 11.
